title: docs(permissions): the hand-written pages describe the security catalog main serves, not the four retired row objects
body:
Fixes #22976
Clause-②: no (docs)

## What this changes

After C3 stage 8 (#23222) and stage 7b (#23302), `main` serves positions, permission sets and capabilities as catalog definitions. The environment registry holds them and answers them by name (ADR-0131 D3), and assignments name them. Nine of the ten hand-written pages on the card still described the four retired row objects (`sys_position`, `sys_permission_set`, `sys_position_permission_set`, `sys_capability`) as stored tables. Some also described the ADR-0094 projector, the data-door write-through, binding rows, or the row-object Setup pages as live. This PR rewrites those passages to say what `main` does. Each rewrite was checked against source at `main` `404fc477e5`. The tenth page, `protocol/backward-compatibility.mdx`, has one mention, and that mention is correct release history, so it is unchanged.

Docs only: 9 files, +149 / −136. There are no edits under `content/docs/releases/**`, `CHANGELOG.md`, ADRs (the `domain:skills` card #22978) or the generated reference pages.

## Re-measure on `main` `404fc477e5`

The grep `sys_position|sys_permission_set|sys_capability` over `content/docs/**`, excluding `releases/**` and `references/**`, matches exactly the card's 10 pages: authorization 11, permission-sets 6, delegated-administration 5, capabilities 3, positions 3, system-context 2, and 1 each on the other four. A second grep for the removed mechanisms (projector, projection, write-through, backfill, walled catalog data door, `isRowActive`, `SystemObjectName.POSITION`, the data-door URLs) adds no page. Its hits outside these pages describe mechanisms that are still live:

- `deployment/cli.mdx`: "mutation projectors". The datasource-admin plugin still registers one.
- `kernel/cluster.mdx`: the registry write-through, `applyRegistryWriteThrough`.
- The seed-tenancy, membership and summary-null backfills, which are unrelated to the catalog.

The two generated reference pages that still mention the objects (`references/api/protocol.mdx` 3, `references/identity/eval-user.mdx` 2) render spec `.describe()` text. That text is residue for the 8-post stage, so those pages are not edited here.

Each mention was judged either a mis-statement or a correct retired statement. A correct "no row is written" or "retired" sentence is kept, as the card allows.

| Page | Line on `main` | Verdict | Done |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `concepts/metadata-lifecycle` | 141 | Mis-statement. It names `POST /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set` as a clone path and says "the refusal does not name it yet". | The row now names what the refusal names: the Clone action or the clone door. |
| `data-modeling/objects` | 336 | Mis-statement. It lists `sys_position_permission_set` as a member of the `system-data` bucket. | Only the two assignment tables are listed. |
| `deployment/environment-variables` | 70 | Mis-statement. The grants-cache watched set lists three retired objects. | Five objects, as in the code. |
| `permissions/authorization` | 36 | Mis-statement. Assignment is described as rows of `sys_permission_set` and `sys_position`. | Catalog definitions, plus the two assignment rows that name them. |
| | 158, 169, 199, 207, 598 | Correct ("no row is written"). | Kept. |
| | 233, 244 (Two doors) | Mis-statement. The projector, the data-door redirect, the data-layer provenance gate, and delete as reset on the data door. | Rewritten to the metadata door: `manage_metadata`, operator-only under a wall, `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` naming the clone. |
| | 415–416 | Mis-statement. "Setup's Deactivate action writes" the row's `active` column. | Setup's catalog switch writes the activation ledger. |
| | 607 | Mis-statement. The lint counts a `sys_capability` seed. | A seed row is not counted. |
| `permissions/capabilities` | 71, 210 | Correct. | Kept. |
| | 215 (callout) | First sentence correct. "Clearing its `active` flag" implies the row is still served. | The object is retired; the ceremony handles old rows. |
| `permissions/delegated-administration` | 29, 37, 38, 53–54 | Mis-statement. The example, the governed-table list, the action-flag row, and the zoo's binding-write case. | Rewritten. |
| `permissions/permission-sets` | 155 | Correct. | Kept. |
| | 241, 247–248 | Junction row and data-layer anchor binding described as live. | The junction is retired; `everyone` is derived, and the gate runs on the derived definition. |
| | 327 (adminScope example) | Mis-statement (`manageBindings`, `sys_position_permission_set`). | Example fixed. |
| | 344–347 | "Data layer refuses forging", "position bindings" revoked on uninstall. | What uninstall does on `main`. |
| | 366, 378 (the "record is a projection" section) | Mis-statement. | Rewritten as "One authoritative store — the definition". |
| | 409, 444 | Data door and record described as live. | Removed. |
| `permissions/positions` | 11, 62 | The junction and `sys_position.name` described as live. | Reworded. |
| | 85 | Correct. | Kept. |
| | Anchors section | Anchor binding described as an admin act and as a data-layer gate. | Derived definition; no caller writes either anchor. |
| `permissions/system-context` | 111 (row 11) | The projector skip is described as live. | Annotated: the plugin no longer registers it; the module is still exported. |
| | 130 (row 23b) | Correct (a name only a legacy row carries is refused). | Kept. |
| | 187 (row 55b) | On `main` it still names the data door on the three retired objects. | **Left to #23231**, whose branch rewrites this row (see Shared pages). |
| | 410–412 | "Resolves against the granting organization's own catalog row". | The read targets an unregistered object and gets no rows. |
| `protocol/backward-compatibility` | 75 | Correct release history (`17.2.0` retired `sys_position.permissions`). | Kept. |

## Sources for the rewrites (`main` `404fc477e5`)

- **Catalog read:** `packages/core/src/security/security-catalog.ts` (module doc). Positions, permission sets and capabilities are read by name from the engine registry first, then from the metadata service. No row is read.
- **Assignments store names:** `sys-user-permission-set.object.ts:109` (`permission_set`, `Field.text`) and `:86` (the legacy `permission_set_id`, plain text, which grants nothing). `sys-user-position.object.ts:84` (`position`). The plugin registers three objects (`objects/index.ts:12-14`).
- **Setup under `single` and under a wall:**
  - `metadata-core/src/meta-write-capability.ts:82` admits a `/meta` write for `manage_metadata` or `isSystem` only.
  - `:169-195` (`walledCatalogWriteVerdict`): under `group` or `isolated`, only the platform operator or `isSystem` may write the catalog. Under `single` the verdict is inert (`:182`).
  - Setup nav: `plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts:1543-1545` (`/apps/setup/metadata/TYPE?scope=environment`).
  - Setup's active switch, at the objectui pin `1fb1ced3`: `app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/catalog-activation.ts` and `ResourceListPage.tsx:148`. It writes `POST /security/_activation/:type/:name`.
- **Packaged sets:** `metadata-protocol/src/packaged-base-regime.ts:194-199` (the clone routes the refusal names) and `managedItemSealedSentence` (`NOT_OVERRIDABLE` / 403). Delete: `protocol.ts:17772` (`refusePackagedBaseRemoval`). `permission` merges at read, so a delete removes only a stored row, and the package's definition stays served.
- **Grants cache:** `core/src/security/resolve-user-grants-cache.ts:117-125` (watched set). `security-plugin.ts:1850-1866` bumps the `metadata` epoch on every metadata change.
- **Lint:** `lint/src/validate-capability-references.ts:16-26`. A seed row is not a source.
- **Delegated-admin gate:**
  - `delegated-admin-gate.ts:131-149` (the governed set still names the two retired objects) and `:396-405` (dispatch).
  - `:818`: `manageAssignments` also gates direct grants.
  - `:993-1048`: `manageBindings` and `authorEnvironmentSets` still take part in containment.
  - The zoo's binding cases are gone: `showcase-permission-zoo.dogfood.test.ts:173-177`.
- **Uninstall:** `plugin-security/src/cleanup-package-permissions.ts:13-25` revokes the grants that name a declared set.
- **Anchors:** `plugin-security/src/builtin-positions.ts:121` registers `guest` with no `permissionSets`. `:138` derives `everyone` from the baseline.
- **Legacy reads:** `objectql/src/engine.ts:10276` (`resolveObjectName` throws `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` for an unregistered object). `plugin-security/src/auto-org-admin-grant.ts:154-176` catches the error and answers `[]`.
- **Old databases:** `cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.ts:38-53` and `:399-405`. Under `single`, authored sets and positions are converted. Authored capability rows are reported. Seeded copies are deleted.

### Measured against ADR-0131 D2/D3 text

The ADR's original reading was that Setup authoring under `single` needs no Studio capability (the organization admin's object grants). The ADR's own text withdraws that reading: the 2026-10-10 note in D2 and D3 (#22621) says Setup authoring under `single` requires `manage_metadata`. `main` does what the withdrawal says (`meta-write-capability.ts:82`), and the pages follow `main`.

## Shared pages

- **#23303** (open, draft) edits `system-context.mdx` (it adds row 47c after row 47) and `backward-compatibility.mdx` (lines 117 and 195, the package count). This PR touches neither hunk. It does not edit `backward-compatibility.mdx` at all, and its `system-context.mdx` edits are rows 11 and the census paragraph near line 410. Whichever PR lands second merges `main`.
- **#23231** has a branch and no PR yet (`claude/issue-23231-walled-environment-metadata-writes` at `e7fdcc48e2`). Its branch edits three of these pages: `capabilities.mdx` (the walled-refusal paragraph, lines 243–249), `permission-sets.mdx` (the walled `/packages` sentences, lines 354–360) and `system-context.mdx` (row 55b). This PR leaves those lines unchanged. On `permission-sets.mdx`, lines 351–353 sit unchanged between the two hunks. Row 55b on `main` still names the data door on the three retired objects. #23231's rewrite already scopes that clause to "while those objects are registered", so the row is left to it.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not in this card (family residue, noted, not filed):**
  - 8-post:
    - The spec `.describe()` texts still cite the retired objects: `permission.zod.ts` `packageId` and `managedBy` ("persisted on `sys_permission_set` records", `bootstrapDeclaredPermissions`), `AdminScopeSchema.manageBindings`, and `sys-user-position.object.ts` `position` ("references `sys_position.name`"). Two generated reference pages render that text.
    - `adminScope.manageBindings` and `authorEnvironmentSets` are spec-declared keys whose primary gates target objects `main` no longer registers. They now take part only in strict containment. The showcase still declares both as `false`. The `permission` liveness row's `adminScope` evidence still cites the two retired objects.
  - 7a: `createPermissionSetWriteThrough` and `registerPermissionSetProjection` are still exported from `@objectstack/plugin-security` (`index.ts:79-80`), but nothing registers them.
  - C7b: the legacy-id reads of `sys_permission_set` and `sys_position` (`auto-org-admin-grant.ts:343-356`, `delegated-admin-gate.ts:1317`, `:1330`, and the grant-name backfill) throw `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`. The errors are caught, so each read answers no rows.
- `delegated-administration.mdx` says "`sys_member` is not one of the gate's governed objects" (the invitation role cap). `GOVERNED_OBJECTS` lists it (`delegated-admin-gate.ts:148`). This is unrelated to the catalog objects, so it is not changed here.
- `permissions/administrator-guide.mdx` is not added to the page list. It names none of the four objects and none of the removed mechanisms. Its Setup walkthrough was not checked against the console at the pin.

## Verification

Local runs on head `260137da82`. CI is not complete yet.

- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 44 commands; all 44 ran and exited 0. `--ran` reconciles: "44 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 44 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 44 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". Selected verdict lines:
  - `check:doc-anchors`: 499 internal fragment links resolve, including the new `permission-sets#package-suggestion--isdefault-adr-0090-d5`.
  - `check:system-context-census`: "OK — 133 elevation read sites … the page cites 126 symbol(s) against 126 required".
  - `check:doc-authoring`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:role-word`, `check:overlay-whitelist-table`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, spec `check:docs` ("226 generated files in sync") and spec `check:skill-examples` (263 prose examples type-check): all green.
  - Two first runs exited 3 with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`. Both were re-run after the lock-held builds of `@objectstack/lint...` and `@objectstack/client-react...` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`), and both then exited 0.
- **Links.** `lychee 0.24.2` with `check-links.yml`'s argv (`--offline --root-dir content --fallback-extensions mdx,md --config lychee.toml` over the four globs): "2460 Total … 0 Errors". `node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs`: 730 links resolve.
- **MDX compile.** `@mdx-js/mdx` 3.1.1 with `remark-gfm` compiled all nine edited pages (9/9). Control: an unclosed `Callout` fails with "Expected a closing tag".
- **`skip-changeset`.** The diff is only `content/docs/**`. Of the 71 non-private `package.json` manifests, none has a `files[]` entry naming `content/`. Control: the same scan for `liveness` matches `packages/spec`.
